Deaf Indian Athlete Wins Gold in Malaysia

A deaf athlete from Rajasthan, Varsha, has won a gold medal for India in Malaysia. She achieved this by competing in discus throw and shot put events. The Indian team secured the gold medal, with Varsha being a key contributor.
